verdict: ROAS surged 57% this period; purchase cadence and local signals need watching.
narrative: Your Meta ads delivered a strong return this period — $3.86 back for every dollar spent, up 57% week-over-week — driven by 24 purchases and $5,781.63 in revenue on $1,498.48 in spend. That said, purchases are arriving in bursts rather than a steady flow, and the final three days of the window (Aug 14–16) recorded zero purchases, which is something to watch as the next week opens. On the local side, Google Business Profile engagement dropped 28% week-over-week, with no recorded actions on Aug 15–16 against a daily average of roughly 18 — we're monitoring this closely. The live-cooking content shoot, planned for Aug 14, is being rescheduled so that real-footage creative can fuel the next round of ad creative; expect that refresh to be in market before month-end alongside the funnel and UTM work closing on Aug 31.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend in the last 28 days — $3.86 earned for every $1 spent on Meta
purchases driven through Meta ads this period, generating $5,781.63 in revenue
drop in Google Business Profile engagement week-over-week, signaling softer local discovery

watch_item.issue: Purchase activity went quiet over the last three days of the period while a single campaign carries 57% of total ad spend — concentration and cadence both need room to breathe.
watch_item.fix: New real-footage creative is being produced now to diversify and refresh what's in market; the ad funnel test closes Aug 31, at which point spend distribution will be rebalanced.
